featured_reviews.name: CS Rahul Taori
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Banana Leaf Restaurant at Golden Nest Bhayandar today. Honestly, the experience did not match the hype. We added our name to the waiting list, waited around 45 minutes, and then watched another party get seated before us despite our name already being registered. That kind of poor queue management immediately sets a bad tone.

Food was mixed. Dosa was decent, chutneys were the best part of the meal, and sambar was average. But the button idlis were disappointing — lacked freshness, texture, and overall taste. For a place known for South Indian food, idlis should be a basic strength.

Service also needs attention. While customers were waiting, staff hardly bothered to switch on fans or manage the crowd comfortably. Hospitality starts before food reaches the table.

I also noticed some online reviews mentioning inconsistent service quality and wait-time frustrations, which matches what I experienced.

Overall: Long wait not worth it, average food, weak service management. Good chutneys alone can’t justify the delay and poor handling. Would think twice before visiting again.

The mediocre food quality and pathetic service are enough to keep me from returning.
